question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, and Claire is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) fullback

segments.text: Initially: Alice: cheerleader, Bob: right winger, Claire: fullback.
So Alice gets Claire's position (fullback), Claire gets Alice's (cheerleader).
So after swap1: Alice: fullback, Bob: right winger, Claire: cheerleader.
Bob gets Claire's position (cheerleader), Claire gets Bob's (right winger).
So after swap2: Alice: fullback, Bob: cheerleader, Claire: right winger.
Claire gets Alice's (fullback), Alice gets Claire's (right winger).
So final: Alice: right winger, Bob: cheerleader, Claire: fullback.
Thus Alice ends as right winger.
